# Markus baseline reproduction boundary

The supplied nested R repository is treated as an untrusted external artifact. The
Python pipeline audits its archive, source pins, prohibited live-refit paths, target
semantics, feature timing, and runtime contract before any prediction can enter a
comparison.

Faithful regeneration requires the exact configured R 4.5.1 executable and a
project-local package lock. Bundled prediction files are never analytical inputs;
the 72-row group forecast log may only be used for a numerical parity diagnostic
after predictions have been regenerated from frozen pre-tournament inputs. A failed
runtime, timing, leakage, provenance, or redistribution check leaves the candidate
out of the derived external-baseline table.
